messages:
sam_sales: Paul from ValuPay asked for an ISMS applicability note for the upcoming 3-week POC. They want: (1) which Annex A controls we assert for a hosted POC, (2) a short list of subprocessors with PII flags, (3) confirmation about key custody (do we use customer-managed keys?), and (4) whether we will allow a one-time penetration test during the POC.

paul_cust: Correct. Procurement wants a succinct one-pager they can attach to the SOW. They also asked if Redwood can accept a limited-penetration test scoped to the POC assets.

leah_sec: Quick answers up front: hosted POC -> Redwood responsible for core platform controls (A.6, A.9, A.10, A.12, A.13). Customer retains responsibility for application-level IAM, user onboarding, and their own data classification (A.8.2). We'll make that clear in the matrix.

omar_se: On keys: hosted POC default = Redwood-managed KMS (we use customer-specific key aliases where requested). If customer requires BYOK (bring-your-own-key) we can support it but only for Private/VPC or with an enterprise DPA addendum. Need to flag that to procurement.

leah_sec: Subprocessors we can disclose for POC: AWS (EC2, S3) - PII: yes; Cloudflare - PII: maybe (edge cache); Managed Postgres vendor - PII: yes; Datadog - PII: no (logs may contain identifiers); Mail provider - PII: only if email flows enabled. Legal to confirm naming.

legal-bot: Suggested clause: "Redwood will provide an ISMS applicability matrix for the POC and an evidence pointer package within three (3) business days of NDA execution. Subprocessor list is current as of delivery date and subject to update per DPA." (legal review recommended).

paul_cust: What about backups and retention? Our risk team will want specifics on snapshot retention and cross-region copying.

leah_sec: For hosted POC: operational snapshots retained up to 14 days, region-local only (no cross-continent replication by default). We will add a line: "Backups: retained <=14 days; geo-replication not enabled for standard POC unless requested and contractually agreed."

omar_se: Penetration test: we allow a single, scoped external pentest for hosted POC. Requirements: (a) scope limited to POC assets only, (b) must be scheduled with 7 days' notice, (c) vendor must sign our pentest NDA and rules of engagement, (d) no social engineering. We will provide target IPs and asset inventory.

leah_sec: We'll add an explicit exclusion: Physical facility security (A.11) and customer HR processes for their users (A.7/A.8.2) are out-of-scope for hosted POC. Also call out that SSO federation setup is customer responsibility (we don't manage customer IdP).

sam_sales: Procurement also asked if Redwood can sign a clause committing deletion of POC data within X days. What's realistic?

leah_sec: We can commit to deletion <=30 calendar days for application data and logs for hosted POC. For Private/VPC, deletion is customer-controlled; Redwood can supply a deletion script and run verification with customer permission. Stronger SLAs require legal approval.

omar_se: I'll prepare a minimal evidence bundle: ISMS overview, control ownership summary, KMS usage notes, backup policy excerpt, pentest RfP template.

artifact-bot: Evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-evidence/pkgs/1801234567-poc-brief.zip (contains: ISMS_overview.pdf, annexA-ownership.csv, kms-notes.md, backup-policy.txt, pentest-ROE.pdf)

paul_cust: Can you add a short statement about whether subprocessors are notified ahead of POC runs? Our procurement requires 30-day notice for subprocessor changes.

leah_sec: We will state that subprocessor changes are communicated per DPA; Redwood provides current subprocessor list and will notify of material changes per contractual terms. We don't typically provide unilateral 30-day notice for short POCs unless written into the contract. We'll flag this as a negotiation point.

sam_sales: Action owners and ETA so I can reply to procurement: we need a one-page matrix + evidence link + sample pentest clause + sample deletion clause.

omar_se: SE: produce one-pager Annex A mapping + pentest ROE snippet 	6 hours (ETA: end of day).

leah_sec: Security: finalize subprocessor PII flags, deletion wording, and exclusion list 	2 business days (ETA: next business morning).

legal-bot: Legal: review suggested clauses (deletion SLA, pentest RfP, subprocessor notice) 	2 business days.

sam_sales: Great. Paul, well send the bundle and one-pager once all owners confirm. Thanks. :thumbsup:
